summary: Redesign goal status and completion output so default messages are concise, readable, and actionable across CLI and Telegram.

steps.description: Implement a shared compact goal-status formatting module that derives overview, progress, and short step digest text from run data; include truncation and multiline normalization rules, then verify with dedicated formatter unit tests.

Update `moltbot goal status` to use the compact formatter by default, keep JSON mode unchanged, and add an explicit path for full-detail output so users can still inspect the full plan when needed; update command wiring and validate with goal-status command tests.

Refactor executor completion summary generation to emit a short digest (counts plus capped highlights) instead of long freeform text, ensure done outputs stay informative, and verify behavior with executor and workflow integration tests.

Apply the compact status and completion text to Telegram `/goal_status` and done notifications, keep PNG/caption fallback and interaction routing intact, and confirm with Telegram goal-command tests that messages are readable and behavior is unchanged.
